name: Salisbury (United States)
description: Ten horizontal stripes alternating yellow and blue, a banner of the historic arms of Salisbury in England.
history: Salisbury is a city in and the county seat of Wicomico County, Maryland. The flag was adopted in 2016 (presented at the city's public brand presentation in April 2016, replacing a black-yellow-black triband with the seal, according to Flags of the World citing SbyNews).
